name: step-viz
title: Step window
description: How it works' window: one search shown step by step as an agent window, from the ask to what changed, with a shimmering status, records as chips, the dot matrix and a ticking timer; picking a step crossfades what is in it.

files.content:
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react' import { VizWindow } from '@/components/visuals/VizWindow' // How it works' window (the website's StepViz.vue): one search shown step by step, as an agent window. The ask in a // filled bubble, what was added to context, a status that shimmers while it works and then says how it went, the // outcome as a sentence with the records it touched as inline chips, and a progress row with the dot matrix and a // ticking timer. Steps: 0 write, 1 sync a source, 2 search (results land where they were found, then glide to the // reranked order), 3 an agent over MCP. One window for every step: picking one keeps the window and crossfades what is // in it, every step's body in one grid cell so the window never resizes; `runs` re-keys the picked body, replaying it. export interface StepVizProps { step: number runs: number[] active: boolean } const windows = [ { name: 'Conare', tag: 'Write', ask: 'Add our refund and shipping policies to docs', context: 'Policies.pdf', working: 'Writing', took: 'Worked for 2s' }, { name: 'Conare', tag: 'Source', ask: 'Keep HubSpot in sync with CRM', context: 'HubSpot', working: 'Syncing', took: 'Synced 3 records' }, { name: 'Conare', tag: 'Search', ask: 'How do refunds work?', context: 'Docs', working: 'Searching', took: 'Reranked in 62 ms' }, { name: 'Your agent', tag: 'MCP', ask: 'How do refunds work?', context: 'Conare', working: 'Thinking', took: 'Worked for 1s' }, ] // Found in one order, shown after the rerank in another: `from` and `to` are each row's place before and after. const results = [ { id: 'Refunds', text: 'Refunds are available for 30 days.', score: '0.91', from: 2, to: 0 }, { id: 'Returns', text: 'Return an item from your orders page.', score: '0.47', from: 0, to: 1 }, { id: 'Shipping', text: 'Orders ship within two days.', score: '0.12', from: 1, to: 2 }, ].map(r => ({ ...r, row: { '--from': r.from, '--to': r.to, '--d': 1200 + r.from * 160 } as CSSProperties, bar: { '--w': r.score, '--d': 2900 + r.to * 120 } as CSSProperties })) // The loader's nine squares, each blinking a beat after the last. const MATRIX_STYLES = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ '--k': i + 1 }) as CSSProperties) const s = (v: Record) => v as CSSProperties function Matrix() { return {MATRIX_STYLES.map((m, i) => )} } export function StepViz({ step, runs, active }: StepVizProps) { return ( <> {windows.map((w, i) => ( {w.name} {w.tag} ))} )} >
{windows.map((w, k) => (

) : k === 2 ? ( // Search: results land where they were found, then glide to the reranked order on a 48px track.

))}

))}
) } export default StepViz const css = ` /* The finished status's play mark, three quarters of the line's size (9px on 12px). */ .ds-step-play { font-size: 0.75em; } `
